# irxforge

`irxforge` is an R package for generating, parsing, and converting data
sets in pharmacometrics.

## Installation

Install the development version from
[GitHub](https://github.com/InsightRX/irxforge) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("InsightRX/irxforge")
```

## Documentation

See at
[`https://insightrx.github.io/irxforge/`](https://insightrx.github.io/irxforge/reference/index.html)
and also in the installed package:
[`help(package = "irxforge")`](https://insightrx.github.io/irxforge/reference).

## License

MIT © InsightRX

# Package index

## All functions

- [`add_nominal_timepoints()`](https://insightrx.github.io/irxforge/reference/add_nominal_timepoints.md)
  : Add nominal timepoints to a dataset
- [`create_demographics_table()`](https://insightrx.github.io/irxforge/reference/create_demographics_table.md)
  : Create a standardized table for demographics information
- [`detect_dataset_type()`](https://insightrx.github.io/irxforge/reference/detect_dataset_type.md)
  : Auto-detect data set type
- [`download_nhanes_cache()`](https://insightrx.github.io/irxforge/reference/download_nhanes_cache.md)
  : Download and cache NHANES data locally
- [`get_nominal_timepoints()`](https://insightrx.github.io/irxforge/reference/get_nominal_timepoints.md)
  : Get nominal timepoints based on vector of timepoints
- [`get_route_from_data_column()`](https://insightrx.github.io/irxforge/reference/get_route_from_data_column.md)
  : Get the route of administration from a vector of routes for doses
- [`irxforge`](https://insightrx.github.io/irxforge/reference/irxforge.md)
  : irxforge package
- [`nm_data_timepoints`](https://insightrx.github.io/irxforge/reference/nm_data_timepoints.md)
  : Example dataset with timepoints in a NONMEM dataset
- [`not_supported_reformat()`](https://insightrx.github.io/irxforge/reference/not_supported_reformat.md)
  : Function that throws an informative error if reformatting is not
  supported.
- [`reformat_data()`](https://insightrx.github.io/irxforge/reference/reformat_data.md)
  : Reformat data between various data set layouts
- [`reformat_data_modeling_to_modeling()`](https://insightrx.github.io/irxforge/reference/reformat_data_modeling_to_modeling.md)
  : Reformat modeling dataset into a properly checked and validated
  modeling dataset.
- [`reformat_data_modeling_to_nca()`](https://insightrx.github.io/irxforge/reference/reformat_data_modeling_to_nca.md)
  : Reformat NCA-type analysis-ready dataset (ARD) into NONMEM-style
  modeling dataset
- [`reformat_data_nca_to_modeling()`](https://insightrx.github.io/irxforge/reference/reformat_data_nca_to_modeling.md)
  : Reformat NCA-type analysis-ready dataset (ARD) into a NONMEM-style
  modeling dataset
- [`reformat_data_sdtm_to_modeling()`](https://insightrx.github.io/irxforge/reference/reformat_data_sdtm_to_modeling.md)
  : Reformat SDTM datasets into NONMEM-style modeling dataset
- [`sample_covariates()`](https://insightrx.github.io/irxforge/reference/sample_covariates.md)
  : Sample covariates using a variety of methods
- [`sample_covariates_bootstrap()`](https://insightrx.github.io/irxforge/reference/sample_covariates_bootstrap.md)
  : Sample covariates using bootstrap
- [`sample_covariates_mice()`](https://insightrx.github.io/irxforge/reference/sample_covariates_mice.md)
  : Sample covariates using multivariate imputation using chained
  equations (mice)
- [`sample_covariates_mvtnorm()`](https://insightrx.github.io/irxforge/reference/sample_covariates_mvtnorm.md)
  : Sample covariates from multivariate normal distributions
- [`sample_covariates_nhanes()`](https://insightrx.github.io/irxforge/reference/sample_covariates_nhanes.md)
  : Sample covariates from the NHANES database
- [`syms_to_exprs()`](https://insightrx.github.io/irxforge/reference/syms_to_exprs.md)
  : Defuse a list of symbols
